WITH "readme_files" AS (
  SELECT
    sc."sample_repo_name" AS "repo_name",
    sc."sample_path" AS "path",
    sc."content" AS "content",
    COALESCE(sc."copies", 1) AS "copies"
  FROM GITHUB_REPOS.GITHUB_REPOS.SAMPLE_CONTENTS AS sc
  WHERE (sc."sample_path" ILIKE 'README.md' OR sc."sample_path" ILIKE '%/README.md')
    AND COALESCE(sc."binary", FALSE) = FALSE
    AND sc."content" IS NOT NULL
),
"split_readme_lines" AS (
  SELECT
    rf."repo_name" AS "repo_name",
    rf."path" AS "path",
    "f"."INDEX"::NUMBER AS "line_number",
    REPLACE("f"."VALUE"::STRING, '\r', '') AS "line_text",
    rf."copies" AS "copies"
  FROM "readme_files" AS rf,
    LATERAL FLATTEN(input => SPLIT(rf."content", '\n')) AS "f"
),
"included_lines" AS (
  SELECT
    sl."repo_name" AS "repo_name",
    sl."path" AS "path",
    sl."line_number" AS "line_number",
    sl."line_text" AS "line_text",
    sl."copies" AS "copies"
  FROM "split_readme_lines" AS sl
  WHERE TRIM(sl."line_text") <> ''
    AND NOT LTRIM(sl."line_text") LIKE '#%'
    AND NOT LTRIM(sl."line_text") LIKE '//%'
),
"repo_languages" AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    l."repo_name" AS "repo_name",
    "lang"."VALUE":"name"::STRING AS "programming_language"
  FROM GITHUB_REPOS.GITHUB_REPOS.LANGUAGES AS l,
    LATERAL FLATTEN(input => l."language") AS "lang"
  WHERE "lang"."VALUE":"name"::STRING IS NOT NULL
),
"line_counts" AS (
  SELECT
    il."line_text" AS "line_text",
    SUM(il."copies") AS "frequency_count"
  FROM "included_lines" AS il
  GROUP BY il."line_text"
),
"line_language_pairs" AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    il."line_text" AS "line_text",
    rl."programming_language" AS "programming_language"
  FROM "included_lines" AS il
  JOIN "repo_languages" AS rl
    ON il."repo_name" = rl."repo_name"
),
"line_languages" AS (
  SELECT
    llp."line_text" AS "line_text",
    LISTAGG(DISTINCT llp."programming_language", ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY llp."programming_language") AS "programming_languages"
  FROM "line_language_pairs" AS llp
  GROUP BY llp."line_text"
)
SELECT
  lc."line_text" AS "line_text",
  lc."frequency_count" AS "frequency_count",
  ll."programming_languages" AS "programming_languages"
FROM "line_counts" AS lc
LEFT JOIN "line_languages" AS ll
  ON lc."line_text" = ll."line_text"
ORDER BY lc."frequency_count" DESC NULLS LAST, lc."line_text" ASC;

WITH "readme_contents" AS (
    SELECT
        "sc"."id" AS "id",

    FROM GITHUB_REPOS.GITHUB_REPOS.SAMPLE_CONTENTS AS "sc"

      )

        "rc"."id" AS "id",

        REGEXP_REPLACE("line_flatten"."VALUE"::STRING, '^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$', '') AS "line_text"
    FROM "readme_contents" AS "rc",
         LATERAL FLATTEN(input => SPLIT(REPLACE("rc"."content", CHR(13), ''), CHR(10))) AS "line_flatten"
),
"included_lines" AS (
    SELECT
        "sl"."id" AS "id",
        "sl"."repo_name" AS "repo_name",

    WHERE "lang_flatten"."VALUE":"name"::STRING IS NOT NULL
),
"line_languages" AS (
    SELECT
        "rlp"."line_text" AS "line_text",

    FROM "repo_line_pairs" AS "rlp"

)

),

WITH "readme_contents" AS (
  SELECT
    "sample_repo_name" AS "repo_name",

    "content"
  FROM GITHUB_REPOS.GITHUB_REPOS.SAMPLE_CONTENTS
  WHERE "sample_path" RLIKE '(^|/)README\\.md$'
    AND COALESCE("binary", FALSE) = FALSE
    AND "content" IS NOT NULL
),
"readme_lines" AS (
  SELECT
    rc."repo_name",
    rc."path",
    RTRIM(s."VALUE"::STRING, CHR(13)) AS "line_text"
  FROM "readme_contents" AS rc,
       LATERAL SPLIT_TO_TABLE(rc."content", CHR(10)) AS s
),
"included_lines" AS (
  SELECT
    "repo_name",
    "path",
    "line_text"
  FROM "readme_lines"
  WHERE TRIM("line_text") <> ''
    AND LTRIM("line_text") NOT LIKE '#%'
    AND LTRIM("line_text") NOT LIKE '//%'
),
"repo_languages" AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    l."repo_name",

  FROM GITHUB_REPOS.GITHUB_REPOS.LANGUAGES AS l,
       LATERAL FLATTEN(input => l."language") AS lang
  WHERE lang."VALUE":"name"::STRING IS NOT NULL
),
"line_frequencies" AS (
  SELECT
    "line_text",
    COUNT(*) AS "frequency"
  FROM "included_lines"
  GROUP BY "line_text"
),

  SELECT DISTINCT
    il."line_text",
    rl."language_name"
  FROM "included_lines" AS il
  INNER JOIN "repo_languages" AS rl

  ON al."line_text" = lf."line_text"
ORDER BY lf."frequency" DESC, lf."line_text" ASC;
